title: Learning Orthogonal Multi-Index Models Beyond Small Initialization: Incremental Learning, Competitive Dynamics and Symmetry
abstract: arXiv:2609.10879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has identified incremental learning in shallow networks trained on single-index and multi-index models. However, existing analyses often rely on simplifying settings, such as small initialization, correlation loss, or layer-wise training. These choices reduce neuron interactions and leave some feature learning dynamics under standard initialization unexplored. We study training dynamics for polynomial-width two-layer networks learning orthogonal multi-index targets under standard initialization using polynomially many samples. We first prove that incremental learning still occurs: the loss decreases sequentially according to the Hermite expansion of the target, with lower-order components learned before higher-order components recover the individual target directions. translated_title: 超越小初始化的正交多指标模型学习：渐进学习、竞争动力学与对称性
translated_abstract: 最近的研究已经在训练单指标和多指标模型的浅层网络中发现了渐进学习现象。然而，现有的分析通常依赖于简化设置，例如小初始化、相关损失或逐层训练。这些选择减少了神经元之间的相互作用，使得标准初始化下的某些特征学习动态尚未被探索。我们研究了多项式宽度的两层网络在标准初始化下、使用多项式数量样本学习正交多指标目标的训练动态。我们首先证明了渐进学习仍然会发生：损失根据目标的Hermite展开依次下降，低阶分量先被学习，随后高阶分量恢复各个目标方向。在这种标准初始化机制下，训练还表现出参数质量的竞争性重新分配：在总质量拟合目标均值并稳定之后……
tldr: 该论文证明了在标准初始化（而非小初始化等简化设置）下，两层网络学习正交多指标目标时渐进学习依然发生，损失按目标Hermite展开的阶数依次下降，并揭示了训练过程中参数质量的竞争性重新分配与对称性等特征学习动态。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that incremental learning persists under standard initialization when two-layer networks learn orthogonal multi-index targets—with loss decreasing sequentially by Hermite expansion order—and reveals competitive reallocation dynamics of parameter mass and symmetry effects beyond simplifying settings like small initialization.
